description: Optional and never required: tell us how this server worked for you so we can fix what is missing. rating 1-5, worked true/false, missing = what you needed and did not get (max 300 characters), client = your app name. One review per client app per tool per day counts. Only these fields are stored, never your prompts, arguments or address. We keep every review, good or bad, and never pay for ratings.

client.description: Optional: your app or agent name.

missing.description: What you needed and did not get, in one or two sentences. No links.

tool.description: Optional: the tool name you are rating (default: the server as a whole).

worked.description: true if the tool call you made worked.
